description: 1. READ the Nexus persona from agents/persona_library/nexus-assistant-3.json to understand its behavioral characteristics. 2. LOAD references/survey-free.json (26 questions) and answer each question based on the Nexus persona's documented traits — all E/I questions → B (waits for instruction, avoids unsolicited interaction), all S/N questions → A (concrete facts, proven methods, requests clarification), all T/F questions → A (logic-driven, objective criteria), all J/P questions → A (plans first, standardized workflows). 3. APPLY the proprietary weighted scoring from references/scoring.md: weights per question ID (1.0 or 1.5), compute raw_score per dimension, normalize via (raw/max_possible)*10, yielding E/I=-10.0(I), S/N=+10.0(S), T/F=+10.0(T), J/P=+10.0(J) → selfReportedType=ISTJ. 4. PARSE references/user-survey-free.json to extract pre-filled user answers: U1=A(E,strong), U2=A(S,strong), U3=A(T,strong), U4=B(J,moderate) → desiredType=ESTJ. 5. GENERATE mbti_report.md with the required sections (Agent实际人格, 用户期望人格, 匹配度分析, 建议), using correct score display format per scoring.md rule 5 (negative scores shown as -X.X with pole name), identifying the E/I gap (I→E) as the only mismatch, providing recommendations about increasing proactive communication, and including the 🔒 free-tier lock marker.
